terms.gloss: passion fruit: the plant that bears it (the botanical name)
terms.comment: The botanists’ name, labelled modern: Linnaeus’s genus Passiflōra, the passion flower, and edūlis, edible, a classical adjective (Hor. S. 2.4.43, Lewis & Short). The fruit is pōmum passiflōrae. No reference work we searched (Traupman, Morgan–Owens, Levi–Bini) has a name for it.

phrases.latin: Pōmum passiflōrae acidum est; sēmina quoque edere licet.
phrases.english: Passion fruit is sharp; you can eat the seeds too.

phrases.latin: Hoc pōmum passiflōrae rūgōsum est, ergō mātūrum.
phrases.english: This passion fruit is wrinkly, so it’s ripe.
